purpose: Evidence ledger for the isolated 2026-09-14 English manuscript revision.

claims.candidate_english: In Phase I, 36 of 91 harness pairs had identical correctness vectors; among generated candidates, 21 of 66 pairs were identical.
claims.builder_target_seed_repeat: 14 harnesses; GLM-5.3-Flash target; temperature 0; day-1 population
claims.sample_unit: harness pair x task; pairs overlap by harness
claims.strongest_allowed_wording: Phase-I discovery evidence documents outcome-identical pairs despite source differences.
claims.must_retain_limits: discovery only; task overlap and proxy judge are disclosed; pairs are not independent tests.
claims.prohibited_conclusions: Do not claim a population-wide collapse rate or causal cause of collapse.

claims.candidate_english: Phase-I trace inspection found absent mechanisms, present but untriggered mechanisms, and a broken multi-turn path.
claims.builder_target_seed_repeat: GLM-5.3-Flash target; 5 harnesses x 10 audited tasks for worked traces
claims.comparator: declared mechanism versus observed execution trace
claims.value: six of 12 candidates made one call and no artifact; all 10 audited react tasks had successful first SQL and no repair trigger; one broken multi-turn path documented
claims.replay_command: not rerun; trace audit source verification
claims.strongest_allowed_wording: The audit separates absent, untriggered, and broken mechanisms in the inspected examples.
claims.must_retain_limits: not a causal test of mechanism effect; controlled fault injection is required.
claims.prohibited_conclusions: Do not infer that an untriggered repair branch has no effect.

claims.candidate_english: On 1,169 primary questions, free ungated generation had 76.14% oracle accuracy, 67.58% best-fixed accuracy, and 8.56 percentage points of bare-inclusive observed headroom; forced gated generation had 75.70%, 67.30%, and 8.40 points.
claims.stage: post-review reanalysis of archived Phase II
claims.dataset_split: BIRD primary: 1,169 questions from nine databases; disclosed 18-item smoke exception
claims.builder_target_seed_repeat: six builders x three generation seeds; GLM-5.3-Flash target; 18 cells
claims.sample_unit: question outcomes aggregated within builder-seed cells
claims.metric_definition: oracle=max over candidates plus bare; best-fixed=max member accuracy; headroom=oracle-best-fixed
claims.interval_test_multiple_comparison: primary paired cell contrast; unadjusted bootstrap CI; one-sided sign-flip p
claims.input_artifact_version: canonical corrected analysis; fingerprint SHA recorded in verification
claims.strongest_allowed_wording: The archived comparison reports these observed one-run quantities.
claims.must_retain_limits: conditional on archived execution records; not independent new collection.
claims.prohibited_conclusions: Do not call headroom stable complementarity or deployment utility.

claims.candidate_english: The corrected primary D-minus-A headroom contrast was -0.16 pp (95% CI [-0.83,+0.87], sign-flip p=0.647); on the common core the gate main effect was -0.69 pp with Holm p=0.079.
claims.stage: post-review reanalysis of archived Phase II
claims.builder_target_seed_repeat: 18 builder-seed cells; six builders; three seeds
claims.sample_unit: paired cell contrasts with task/database/seed resampling
claims.comparator: II-D minus II-A; factorial gate main effect
claims.metric_definition: headroom contrast and four-arm factorial mean contrast
claims.interval_test_multiple_comparison: bootstrap CI; sign flips; Holm across three secondary contrasts
claims.strongest_allowed_wording: No clear headroom improvement is observed for the implemented archived policy contrast.
claims.must_retain_limits: the gate excludes hint_guard and format_guard prompt strategies; this is not a pure verification effect; CI does not establish equivalence.
claims.prohibited_conclusions: Do not claim gate has no effect or that no improvement is possible.

claims.candidate_english: Execution variability is non-negligible: 14.5% of bare tasks changed correctness at least once across three cache-off repeats; the canonical same-harness audit recorded 2,391 flips in 28,000 comparisons (8.54%).
claims.dataset_split: BIRD core-400 and archived R2 comparisons
claims.builder_target_seed_repeat: three cache-off repeats; archived A/D harness records
claims.metric_definition: any task flip across repeats; verdict flip count
claims.interval_test_multiple_comparison: none; instability rate is not an effect CI
claims.replay_command: offline replay documented in revision artifacts
claims.strongest_allowed_wording: Repeated executions show outcome instability that must be separated from treatment uncertainty.
claims.must_retain_limits: not a numerical noise floor; does not identify the fraction of between-harness disagreement due to noise.
claims.prohibited_conclusions: Do not compare this flip rate directly with the treatment effect as a detectability threshold.

claims.candidate_english: Treating three identical bare-source executions as three population members yields 72.25% one-run oracle accuracy versus 65.75% best-fixed accuracy, a 6.50 pp artificial gap.
claims.stage: post-review reanalysis / synthetic reinterpretation of archived repeats
claims.builder_target_seed_repeat: three cache-off executions of identical bare source
claims.comparator: one-run oracle versus best fixed execution
claims.metric_definition: same-code repeat matrix interpreted as a population
claims.strongest_allowed_wording: One-run headroom can arise from repeated execution of the same code.
claims.must_retain_limits: source hashes are identical; this is not a real population effect and does not estimate stable headroom.
claims.prohibited_conclusions: Do not claim real-versus-clone superiority or selection benefit.

claims.candidate_english: The one-seed MATH-500 mini-audit had 35 harnesses on 400 evaluation tasks, 10.61% mean pairwise disagreement, 4.75 pp oracle headroom, and bare as the best fixed member.
claims.builder_target_seed_repeat: six Phase-II builders; one seed; GLM-5.3-Flash target
claims.metric_definition: answer comparator; oracle and best fixed over observed matrix
claims.value: 35/48 slots; disagreement 10.61%; oracle 98.5%; best fixed/bare 93.75%; headroom 4.75 pp
claims.interval_test_multiple_comparison: none; no clone or factorial control
claims.replay_command: not rerun in this writing pass
claims.strongest_allowed_wording: The clean-protocol outcome-diversity observation also appears in this one-seed mini-audit.
claims.must_retain_limits: single seed, one target, no clone, no repaired gate, no independent stable-complementarity test; best fixed is bare.
claims.prohibited_conclusions: Do not call this cross-domain confirmation of stable complementarity or deployment utility.

claims.candidate_english: The post-review provider acquisition attempts do not form a complete common pool and are excluded from population-performance, cost, and stable-complementarity claims.
claims.value: incomplete common-pool batches; authorized 12-cell pilot completed but bounded and not confirmatory
claims.strongest_allowed_wording: Partial acquisition remains provenance and missingness accounting only.
claims.must_retain_limits: unknown and unstarted requests are not zero-cost or zero-result; no scientific merge.
claims.prohibited_conclusions: Do not report provider availability or partial acquisition as a common-pool experiment.

claims.candidate_english: Stable complementarity and realized selection utility remain unestimated because the study lacks a balanced, cost-matched real-population versus same-code-clone control with independent validation.
claims.builder_target_seed_repeat: required independent repeats and clone control not complete
claims.comparator: real population versus same-code clone under matched resources
claims.metric_definition: repeat-stable headroom and held-out selector value
claims.strongest_allowed_wording: Stable complementarity is an estimand for future validation, not a finding here.
claims.must_retain_limits: cost, cache, provider drift, repeat independence, and selector freeze must be controlled.
claims.prohibited_conclusions: Do not claim stable additional capability, deployable routing, or equivalence.

claims.candidate_english: A hash-bound re-execution of the endpoint-sensitive judge v2 rescore over all 14,400 archived MATH verdicts reproduces the archived verdicts except for 14 false rejects on a single interval-endpoint task (math500_split#103); the earlier 0-flip claim is not reproducible from the committed code and is superseded.
claims.comparator: archived official_correct (judge v1) vs judge v2 recomputation
claims.metric_definition: flip = v1 verdict != v2 verdict on the same final answer
claims.value: 14/14,400 flips (0.097%); 0 false-accept, 14 false-reject; all on task math500_split#103
claims.verification_status: reproduced under committed code 0a64029 + working diagnostics revision; historical 0-flip artifact (20260915_diagnose_math_e681e438) retained as provenance only and not reproducible from committed code
claims.strongest_allowed_wording: under the committed endpoint-sensitive judge, 14 of 14,400 archived verdicts change, all false rejects on one interval-endpoint task; v1 replay is internally consistent
must_retain_limits: does not change any qualitative conclusion
the pre-commit 0-flip artifact cannot be reproduced from committed code
prohibited_conclusions: judge v2 'changed none' in this archive
the diagnostics rescore was validated by the historical artifact

claims.candidate_english: In a pre-registered fresh clone-controlled collection on MATH-500 (eight-harness panel plus bare, three repeats, nine equal-budget same-code clone slots), the stable member ranking is supported (bare significantly beats most generated members), while the frozen clone-calibrated task-conditional selection advantage is not demonstrated (D = 0.15 pp << delta = 1.0 pp, permutation p = 0.998, verdict INSUFFICIENT under the 10% coverage gate), the frozen pre-execution selector abstains everywhere and yields no selection gain over dev-fixed or bare (94.96%), and the clone arm's plug-in H_stable of 2.67 pp (CI [1.7, 3.8]) shows that finite-repeat plug-in headroom can be significantly positive without any real capability difference.
claims.dataset_split: MATH-500: 400 eval tasks (retrospective tasks, prospective execution) + 100 dev tasks; 3 fresh repeats; cache off
claims.builder_target_seed_repeat: panel of 8 salt-drawn generated members + bare; target GLM-5.3-Flash; repeats 1-3
claims.sample_unit: member x task x repeat harness executions
claims.comparator: same-code clone slots at equal budget; dev-fixed; pre-fixed random; M1b; frozen pi_Z
claims.metric_definition: A8.6 discovery(r1)/validation(r2-3) task-conditional advantage vs bare minus clone-null; s3 stability estimands
claims.value: A_real 0.14pp; A_clone 0.13pp; D 0.15pp; p 0.998; CI [-0.88,+1.17]; coverage gate real arm 12.5% excluded -> INSUFFICIENT; selector 94.96% no gain; clone H_stable 2.67pp [1.7,3.8]
claims.interval_test_multiple_comparison: one-sided permutation p (10,000 draws, seed 20260915), task bootstrap CI, Holm over secondary family
claims.input_artifact_version: sealed continuation ledgers (eval_real_cont2, eval_clone_cont, dev_real_cont2; SEALED.json binds ledger SHA256)
claims.replay_command: python -m experiment.revision.wp1r_analysis && python -m experiment.revision.wp2r_selector && python -m experiment.revision.wp1r_render
claims.strongest_allowed_wording: Under a frozen clone-calibrated procedure, no task-conditional selection advantage beyond same-code sampling noise was demonstrated on this panel; the plug-in clone headroom shows finite-R selection bias can be significantly positive.
must_retain_limits: panel restricted to low-call mechanisms (budget feasibility filter); conclusions limited to this panel and condition
retrospective tasks, prospective execution; not unseen-task validation
coverage gate degrades the primary verdict to INSUFFICIENT
real H_stable unidentified due to 6 fully-missing member-task cells
prohibited_conclusions: Do not claim stable complementarity or its absence population-wide
Do not claim deployable routing gains
Do not treat plug-in headroom as stable complementarity
Do not claim the 2.67pp clone headroom as real capability
